LanguageData.MX_Power_AbilitiesSealed: Character abilities are sealed at level 3.
LanguageData.MX_Power_SealedDescription: Level 3: active abilities and core passives are sealed; signature equipment uses low-power stats. Identity, appearance, quests and save safeguards remain. Already-pending returns complete safely; new automatic resurrection is disabled.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Original: Default: retain Zhaoli's original mechanics and values.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Original: Default: retain Mingyuan's original mechanics and values.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Balanced: Level 2: strong vanilla-tier target. Retains the complete skill kit and Karma links, with bounded area, cooldowns, sentencing, growth and substitution. Independent of other characters.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Balanced: Level 2: strong vanilla-tier target. Keeps Life Burn, Self Burn, Overburn, meaningful reserve healing, both bow forms and every skill. Armor applies; age-based instant kills and runaway chains are removed.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Decorative: Level 3: seals skills, growth, Karma gain, substitution and new rebirth; weaker weapons and armor. Existing fields and enchantments end.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Decorative: Level 3: seals skills, burns, reserve healing, reflection, special resistance and new rebirth. The bow becomes a weak ordinary single shot; persistent effects end.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Duanzhan: Level 2: radius 3, line length 5. 26 cut damage, x1.15 on the center line, 30% AP. Normal body-part selection and armor; retains enchantment synergy. Cooldown 12,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_DeathField: Level 2: radius 4.9 for 9 seconds. Every second adds 1 sentence stack and 1 armored cut damage. Nine stacks resolve for 22 cut damage, 30% AP; no guaranteed kill or corpse removal. Up to 3 Karma per 10 seconds. Cooldown 18,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Guiyi: Level 2: costs 2 Karma to heal up to 20 ordinary injury severity on an ally and establish a link. Not self-targetable; no disease, addiction, scar or limb cure. Range 20; cooldown 15,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Dingshu: Level 2: costs 8 Karma and channels for 5,000 ticks to resurrect. Retains the 12-day revival lock and link; adds vanilla resurrection sickness instead of an extra full cleanse. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Minghuo: Level 2: 3 Karma, duration 5,000 ticks. Damage/AP x1.10, hit chance x1.05, attack speed x1.08, reach +0.5. Adds flame damage equal to 10% of base weapon power. Cooldown 30,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Minshen: Level 2: costs 3 Karma; 7x7 area. 35% slow for 6 seconds, with an 8% chance of a 6-second daze instead. Five 1-point armored blunt pulses; mechs take 10 EMP. Cooldown 18,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Passives: Level 2: up to 3 links, lasting 5 days; substitution at most once per day. Growth keeps 25% of the original deviation with its existing cap. Small recruited utility bonuses and 10-day rebirth remain. Sentencing earns Karma without requiring a kill.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Bow: Level 2: Focus charges for 3 seconds, range 30.9, 24 arrow damage, 30% AP, normal aim/cover chance; adds 15 Life Burn, bursts only at 100 layers. Radiation: 9-cell 90-degree sector, up to 4 targets per 2 seconds, 2 damage and 5 layers each. Walls block hits.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_Sword: Level 2: base power 24, 30% AP, base interval 2.2 seconds; +3% dodge offset. Retains Self Burn/Life Burn synergy. Final attack values depend on pawn state.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_AscendantFlameDash: Level 2: dash up to 24 cells; 8 armored burn damage, 12 Life Burn, 0.75-second stun and 1-cell knockback. Gain 20 Self Burn. Trail lasts 5 seconds, adding 3 layers per 2 seconds. Cooldown 2,500 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_InstantCombustion: Level 2: radius 8; one ordinary 8-point burn hit, no forced brain/eye damage. Adds 50% of existing Life Burn (10-25 layers), stuns for 1.5 seconds. Cooldown 30,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_BurningPillar: Level 2: radius grows from 1 to 4.5, lasts 15 seconds, controllable after 3 seconds, core HP 80-160. Every 2 seconds deals 4 combined cut/burn damage plus Life Burn; center favors burn, edge cut. Building damage capped at 6 per pulse. Cooldown 45,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_TimeBurn: Level 2: freezes one pawn for 4 seconds; 4 burn damage per second, 12 on completion. No aging, guaranteed death or material generation. Buildings take one 40-point burn hit. Warmup 3 seconds, range 25, cooldown 45,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_AshesOfSelf: Level 2: costs 12% blood loss, grants 80 Self Burn. Following aura lasts 10 seconds; every 2 seconds deals 1 burn damage and 3 Life Burn (+1 per 100 Self Burn), heals 0.5 ordinary injury severity. Self Burn recovery capped at 3 per pulse. No building demolition or animal execution. Cooldown 12,000 ticks.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_LifeBurn: Level 2: absolute threshold/cap 100. Every 2 seconds deals 0.5 + 1 per 100 layers armored burn damage; full stacks burst for 18 and clear. Penalties capped at 10%; no self-growth, gear destruction, need drain or aging. Decay after 10 seconds; death transfers 10 layers to up to 3 enemies within 6 cells.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_SelfBurn: Level 2: scales to 300 layers: +18% melee/skill damage, +12% ranged weapon damage, +12% attack speed, +10% movement, +15% work. Above 300, Overburn multiplies damage by 1.08 and active Life Burn by 1.15 while draining reserve. Drafted regeneration: +1 layer per 2 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_BurningBody: Level 2: incoming damage x0.90; heat additionally x0.50, explosions x0.70. No invulnerability, fire-triggered full heal, consciousness boost or need exemption. Heals 2 ordinary injury severity per 2,500 ticks. Hits grant 3 Self Burn; reflect 12% of actual damage (max 3) and 2 Life Burn. Melee/ranged hits add 4/2 layers (+1/+0.5 per 100 Self Burn).
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield: Level 2: 80 reserve, no direct damage blocking. Every 10 seconds spends 1 to heal up to 3 ordinary injury severity. Convert 4 Self Burn per reserve, spending up to 60 per conversion, cooldown 2,500 ticks. Undrafted and unharmed for 2,500 ticks: restore one missing part or scar per day for 20 reserve. Overburn still drains reserve.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame: Level 2: death deals 12 ordinary burn damage to enemies within 2.4 cells, with no massive explosion or long stun. Returns after 1 day. Level 3 blocks new rebirths; already-pending returns finish safely.
LanguageData.MX_Power_Zhaoli_Shield: Level 2: sentencing grants 1 shield counter, capped at 6; taking damage consumes 1. As in the original implementation, these counters do not directly absorb damage.
LanguageData.MX_Power_BalancedEquipment: Level 2 equipment. Signature visuals and identity remain; armor, insulation and bonuses are tuned together with the full loadout and character passives. See the actual stats in the information panel.
